module.purpose: Provides the React Flow viewport container that initializes pan-and-zoom behavior, synchronizes viewport state, and renders child content inside the renderer element.
module.summary: This module defines the viewport interaction boundary for a React Flow renderer. It creates and destroys an XY pan-zoom instance, forwards viewport lifecycle events to store callbacks, updates controlled or uncontrolled transforms, responds to interaction settings and keyboard state, and supplies the renderer DOM node to shared state. Resize handling and configurable wheel, pinch, drag, selection, and context-menu behavior are coordinated through React effects.
module.businessContext: Supports interactive graph visualization by managing viewport navigation and rendering containment. Failure disables panning, zooming, viewport synchronization, and related graph interactions.
functions: ZoomPane (~L26-153): Initializes viewport interaction behavior and renders the graph renderer container.
systemCapabilities: Forward viewport and movement lifecycle events

io: Creates and configures DOM-based pan-and-zoom interaction on the renderer element.
mutationOfArg: Mutates shared Zustand state with pan-zoom, transform, DOM node, and dragging state.

moduleContractTests.scenario: When ZoomPane renders, it exposes the renderer container and renders its children.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Pins the DOM container class and child composition required by the renderer.

moduleContractTests.scenario: When the pane mounts with a DOM node, it initializes pan-zoom and stores the instance and initial transform.
given: zoomPane.current is a mounted renderer element
moduleContractTests.rationale: Guards synchronization between the pan-zoom instance and the application store.

moduleContractTests.scenario: When an uncontrolled pane changes transform, it reports the viewport and updates the store transform.
moduleContractTests.then: onViewportChange is called with { x: 100, y: 200, zoom: 2 } and store.getState().transform === transform
moduleContractTests.rationale: Pins the controlled-versus-uncontrolled viewport synchronization contract.

moduleContractTests.scenario: When a controlled pane changes transform, it reports the viewport without replacing the store transform.
moduleContractTests.then: onViewportChange is called with { x: 100, y: 200, zoom: 2 } and store.setState is not called with { transform }
moduleContractTests.rationale: Prevents controlled viewports from being mutated by local transform handling.

moduleContractTests.scenario: When pan-zoom lifecycle callbacks fire, corresponding move and viewport callbacks receive the event and viewport.

moduleContractTests.then: onMoveStart, onViewportChangeStart, onMove, onViewportChange, onMoveEnd, and onViewportChangeEnd are called with the expected arguments
moduleContractTests.rationale: Ensures all lifecycle boundaries remain observable to consumers.

moduleContractTests.scenario: When the pane unmounts after initialization, its pan-zoom instance is destroyed.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Guards cleanup of DOM listeners and pan-zoom resources.

detail.name: ZoomPane
detail.signature: export function ZoomPane({ onPaneContextMenu, zoomOnScroll = true, zoomOnPinch = true, panOnScroll = false, panOnScrollSpeed = 0.5, panOnScrollMode = PanOnScrollMode.Free, zoomOnDoubleClick = true, panOnDrag = true, defaultViewport, translateExtent, minZoom, maxZoom, zoomActivationKeyCode, preventScrolling = true, children, noWheelClassName, noPanClassName, onViewportChange, isControlledViewport, paneClickDistance, selectionOnDrag }: ZoomPaneProps)
preconditions: The component is rendered within a store context providing the required React Flow store API.
The rendered container is available as a DOM element before pan/zoom initialization occurs.
postconditions: The renderer container is rendered with the react-flow__renderer class and supplied children.
Pan/zoom state, the current transform, and the nearest react-flow DOM node are registered in the store after initialization.
Configured pan/zoom options are passed to the pan/zoom instance whenever their dependencies change.
The pan/zoom instance is destroyed when the component is unmounted.
invariants: Viewport changes are reported through onViewportChange when provided.
Uncontrolled viewport changes update the store transform; controlled viewport changes do not update the store transform through onTransformChange.
Pan/zoom start, active, and end callbacks delegate to the corresponding store callbacks when provided.
paneDragging is only updated when its value changes.
edgeCases: When optional interaction callbacks are absent, no callback is invoked for that event.
When default interaction options are omitted, scrolling zoom, pinch zoom, double-click zoom, dragging, and scrolling prevention default to enabled, while panning on scroll defaults to disabled.
When the renderer DOM node is unavailable during initialization, the initialization effect performs no pan/zoom setup.
When isControlledViewport is true, onTransformChange still reports the viewport but does not write the transform to the store.
stateMutations: Store panZoom is set to the created pan/zoom instance.
Store transform is initialized from the pan/zoom instance viewport.
Store domNode is set to the nearest ancestor with the react-flow class.
Store paneDragging is updated from pan/zoom dragging state.
Store transform is updated for uncontrolled viewport changes.
detail.ioFormatSpec: Renders a div with className="react-flow__renderer", containerStyle, a ref to the renderer element, and the supplied children. Viewport callback payloads use the shape { x, y, zoom }.
detail.summary: ZoomPane renders the React Flow renderer container and connects it to pan/zoom interaction handling. It initializes pan/zoom state, propagates viewport and movement changes, and applies the configured interaction options.
